title: SEC1: Add regex edge-case tests to sieve-native
description:
The glob-to-regex conversion in evaluator.rs::sieve_glob_to_regex() lacks test coverage for edge cases:

- Glob patterns with special characters that need escaping (*, ?, ., +, [, ], {, }, etc.)
- Escaped literals: 'test\*' should match literal 'test*', not as wildcard
- Malformed regex patterns that cause compilation failure (handled silently with unwrap_or(false) at line 434)
- Interaction of glob matching with case-insensitive comparators

Without these tests, future refactoring of the glob-to-regex logic or upgrades to fancy-regex could silently introduce matching bugs.

Acceptance criteria:
- At least 5 new tests covering glob edge cases
- At least 1 test for escaped special chars
- Cross-validate all new tests against sieve-rs oracle
